messages.ko: 어제 콘서트를 마지막으로 이번 서울콘이 끝났는데 모두 즐거웠던 콘서트였으면 좋겠다ㅜ 이것저것 준비하고 정신없이 휘몰아치던 준비기간이였던것같은데 막상 무대에 서니  준비하면서 들었던 걱정들 두려움 다 사라지고 너무 재밌고 행복하더라고 콘서트 많이 와줘서 너무 고맙고 앞으로도 이렇게 오래오래 함께하면 좋겠다ㅇ
messages.en: With yesterday's concert, our Seoul concerts have come to an end, and I hope everyone had a wonderful timeㅜ It feels like the preparation period was a whirlwind of getting all sorts of things ready, but once I actually stood on stage, all the worries and fears I had while preparing disappeared, and I had so much fun and felt so happy. Thank you so much for coming to the concerts, and I hope we can stay together like this for a long, long timeㅇ
I think this will become another wonderful memoryㅏ
I'm on my way to my schedule right now!
But WAVs, seriously,
you're tone-deaf.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
The fanchant was made like a rap, so I couldn't really tell,
but I heard you when I got everyone to sing together,
and the dissonance was unbelievable.
ㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It was cute.
It was even cuter because I could tell you were singing so hard.
I was so nervous preparing Nuneoye, too,
so I'm really glad you liked it.

messages.ko: 막콘 누너예 때 빈이 집업 뺏어입은 거 해명해주세여
messages.en: Please explain why you stole Bini's zip-up and wore it during Nuneoye at the final concert.
Wait, what are you talking about?
You startled me.
The costume team prepared it for me.
Right before Bini went in,
she said, 'It's mine,'
and then walked away.
I was like, 'What does she mean…?'
Does she mean I'm hers?
That's what I thought,
but after seeing the Cotalk messages, I realized she was talking about the outfit.
It was originally Jiwoo unnie's, but she said she wasn't going to wear it,
so they switched it to mine.
That really surprised me.
I also had my bangs swept back for the first time in a while.
How was it?
I was originally going to do a half-swept-back style,
but it didn't suit the other songs, so I went with a comma-shaped bang for Nuneoye.
It flew away while I was dancing,
so I ended up looking like someone with just one strand of bangs hanging down.
You didn't wipe your sweat as frantically this time, huh???
Oh, right!

messages.ko: 내가 처음으로 땀 방지 페이스 패드?
messages.en: For the first time, I used an anti-sweat face pad?
I tried one,
and I really didn't sweat much.
Please explain why you held SoomSoom's hand instead of Bini's.
Why do I have so many things to explain?
I was supposed to just walk out normally for that part, too,
but suddenly someone grabbed my hand.
So I couldn't do the gesture I was going to do,
and I changed it ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It was Kim Soomin ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It's so funny that Bini was confused, too..
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ She was just standing there looking bewildered.
And something I'm proud of.
I worked so hard drawing on the signed balls.

messages.ko: 원래 포켓몬애둘만 해서 포켓볼 만들려고 했는데
messages.en: I was originally going to draw only two Pokémon and make them into Poké Balls, but
I ran out of characters I could draw,
so I drew various characters.
I'm eating jjondigi right now,
and it's delicious.
I had a crepe earlier, too.
No, seriously,
what hairstyle suits me the best?
Think about it seriously.
You like something simple and safe, huh?
Thinking deeply.
Hmm.
During the tour,
I'll try to experiment with different hairstyles.
You'll have to see what suits me and what I shouldn't do,
so watch closely, okay?
Oh, and also,

messages.ko: 내가 모두에게 만족할수 있는 콘서트를 한게 아닌것같아서 너무너무 미안한 마음이 자꾸 들고 앞으로도 더 노력할거지만 내 몸은 한개라는걸 조금 이해해줬으면 좋겠어ㅓ..
messages.en: I keep feeling so, so sorry because I don't think I was able to put on a concert that satisfied everyone. I'll keep working harder, but I hope you can understand a little that I only have one bodyㅓ..
I'll show you how I keep getting better.

messages.ko: 콘서트하면서 가장 기억에 남는건 컨페티가 눈처럼 내릴때 보는 반짝반짝한 관객석이 진짜 웨이브도 보여주고 싶을만큼 너무너무 이뻐서 기억에 남는데 관객석에서 바라보는 나도 존재만으로도 좋은기분만 심어주고 싶고      Y/n가 날 좋아해주고 응원해주는게 나의 자랑이고 그런 자부심이 나의 원동력이니까    Y/n도 이번 콘서트 이후론 지금보다 더 행복한 사람 빛나는사람이 되길 바랄게
messages.en: What I remember most from the concert is how beautiful the audience looked, sparkling as the confetti fell like snow. It was so pretty that I really wanted WAVs to be able to see it, too. I want to leave you with good feelings just by being someone you watch from the audience. Y/n loving and supporting me is something I'm proud of, and that pride is what drives me. I hope that after this concert, Y/n will become even happier and shine even brighter than before.

messages.ko: 나도 아직 콘서트 여운에서 못벗어나고 있거등
messages.en: I still haven't gotten over the afterglow of the concert, either.

messages.ko: 컨페티 사이에서 응원봉 흔들면서 돌아다니는 하여니 보니까 진짜진짜 예쁘더라 계속 기억나서 일기장에두 적어놧어
messages.en: Seeing you, Hayeoni, walking around and waving your lightstick among the confetti was so, so beautiful. I keep remembering it, so I even wrote it down in my diary.
Now I want to steal that diary.
If I was shining and WAVs were shining, too,
then Jangchung must have been filled with lights that day.
Heh.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Write it in your diary, too.
I should write in my diary for the first time in a while, too.
Looking at the first entry,

messages.ko: 곧 내가 공개된다!! 어떨까 미래의 하연아 어때??
messages.en: It says, 'I'm going to be revealed soon!! I wonder what it'll be like. Future Hayeon, how is it??'

messages.ko: 하우스에 입주했다 오늘 혜린이랑 연지랑 좀 친해진것 같았다 다 친해질 수 있겠지..?
messages.en: I moved into the house. I think I got a little closer to Hyerin and Yeonji today. I can become friends with everyone, right..?
Things like that were written in it.
Reading it now gives me such a strange feeling.

messages.ko: 난 항상 일기에 미래의 나한테 질문을 적어놔
messages.en: I always write questions to my future self in my diary.
At the very end, I write,
Today's question.
Did you achieve this?

messages.ko: 너는 지금 이 걱정 없어? 이런거
messages.en: Do you not worry about this anymore? Things like that.
I've already answered all of them.
And when I write in my diary,
rather than writing while being completely immersed in the present,

messages.ko: 미래의 내가 이걸보고 내가 이랬었지 이런 상황이였지 느끼고 위로를 받았으면 좋겠어서
messages.en: I hope my future self will read it, remember how I was and what the situation was like, and find comfort in it.
Almost like I'm a second person.

messages.ko: 하연아 난 영원한 너의 편이고 항상 힘내 이런거
messages.en: Things like, 'Hayeon, I'm always on your side, so keep going.'
When I write those things down and go back to read them when things are hard,
they really give me strength.
I think I really do tend to live with a focus on the future.
Or maybe not.
Rather than focusing on the future,
I think it's more that I don't want to stay stuck in the past.
You don't like regretting the past or settling for the present.
That's rightㅏ

messages.ko: 그래서 Y/n가 날 좋아하기 전을 생각하기 보단
messages.en: So rather than thinking about the time before Y/n started liking me,

messages.ko: 우리가 얼마나 많은시간 동안 앞으로 같이 있을 수 있는지를 생각하지
messages.en: I think about how much time we can spend together from now on.

messages.ko: 그럼 하연이는 후회될때 어떻게 해결하는 편이야?
messages.en: Then how do you deal with regret, Hayeon?
Regret it enough, then become twice as good.
What do you do when you feel like the whole world is unfairly picking on you?
There's something called the law of total hardship.

messages.ko: 그만큼 힘들면 또 그만큼 좋은일도 생긴다
messages.en: If things are that hard, then good things will happen to the same extent.
If a lot of difficult things all happen at once,

messages.ko: 또 얼마나 좋은일이 몰아서 오려고하나 생각하세요
messages.en: think about how many good things must be coming your way all at once.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
I'm serious about this.
This is science.
Since we're still basking in the concert afterglow today,
let's have a serious-talk day.
You've had your fill of serious talk, right?

messages.ko: 하연이랑 진지한 얘기 하는 거 좋아... 정하연이라는 사람에 대해 더 잘 알 수 있는 것 같아서
messages.en: I like having serious conversations with you, Hayeon... It feels like I can get to know the person Jeong Hayeon a little better.

messages.ko: 그치 속마음 얘기하는 시간이 많이 없으니까
messages.en: Right? We don't get many chances to talk about what's really on our minds.

messages.ko: 저 콘서트 다녀온 뒤부터 계속 하연이 나오는 꿈 꾸는데 어떻게 하나요... 진지해요
messages.en: I've been dreaming about you ever since I went to the concert. What should I do... I'm serious.
That's because I'm the one visiting you in your dreams.
Why don't you come into my dreams, then?
I was going to, but you were having a really scary dream.

messages.ko: 힛더플로어 - 앤드리스 연속으로 이어지는 부분은 너무 힘들지 않나요?
messages.en: Isn't the part where Hit the Floor goes straight into Andless really exhausting?
Oh, right.
I stumbled for a moment then,

messages.ko: 이미 바닥에 쓰러져있는 사람한테 걸려서 넘어진거야
messages.en: but I tripped over someone who was already lying on the floor and fell.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I still don't know who that person was.
It was dark,

messages.ko: 그냥 같이 쓰러져있는 상태로 끌려나간 기억만 있어 ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
messages.en: and I only remember being dragged off while we were both lying there ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 힛더플로어에서 엔드리스 갈 때 차인 사람~? 하고 단톡에 물어보자
messages.en: Let's ask in the group chat, 'Who got kicked when Hit the Floor went into Andless~?'
I feel like everyone would say it was me.
Andless is so my style, though.
Glad to hear that.
Oh, and also,
At the send-off,
everyone saluted me whenever they came up to me.
Even Jiwoo unnie said beside me,
'Is everyone saluting you because you're the leader?'
That's what she asked,
and I was like, 'Maybe.'
That's what I said,
but when I thought about it,
it was actually a badge war.
Wasn't it because you're the leader?!!
Who knows the truth ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Then from now on, Hexagons,
I expect you to salute me first when you see me.
Shouldn't we make a chant, like 'Sa-lute!'?
We already made one.
Hex! A-gon!!

messages.ko: 읭 난  하요이 보면 사랑한다고 하려했는데...?? 그걸로 퉁치면 안됨??
messages.en: Huh? I was going to tell Hayoi I love her when I see her...?? Can't that count instead??
Then, like in The New Recruit 4,
Hex! A-gon! I love you!
How about that?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
No, you'd have to rap to say all that in such a short time.
Hexagon, I love you, Hayeon, you were so pretty today, see you again!
Three seconds is enough.
It's okay if the pronunciation gets all slurred because we're saying it so fast, right?
Then it'll be like that Reel.

messages.ko: 빨리 답하려다 이상하게 말했을때 오는 자괴감릴스 알아?
messages.en: You know that Reel about the regret you feel after trying to answer quickly and saying something weird?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅋㄹㅋ
You know the one,
where you're at a restaurant and say to the owner,

messages.ko: 사장님 음식 너무 맛있어요 하고 지나가는데
messages.en: 'The food is so delicious!' as you walk by,
but they talk to you so suddenly
that you stumble over your words and cringe about it afterward.

messages.ko: 아 뭐 영원히 그 말만 메아리마냥 생각나는 그런 느낌?
messages.en: Oh, like when those words keep echoing in your head forever?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
That happens to me so often, too.
It happens a lot when I meet WAVs.

messages.ko: 그거 하연이가 저번에 지나가던 웨이브가 예쁘다해서 대답하다가 절었다던 그런상황아냐?ㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Isn't that like the time you said you stumbled over your words when a passing WAV called you pretty? ㅋㅋㅋ
Exactly ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
At the send-off, too, when someone walked past and said,
'Hayeon, see you again!!'
I could just say,
'See you again~,'
but I keep repeating exactly what they say,
so I end up saying the exact same thing, 'Hayeon, see you again,'
It's driving me crazy.
I should get going now.
You worked hard today, too~
Sleep well and eat crepes~
Haranghae❤️❤️
